scope: Internal source/package integrity audit only; no proof execution or CI-success inference

current_acceptance_record.status_scope: Full automated verification for the current revision

required: Actual exit code 0 and fresh complete PASS verification reports
Every required stage and both addition/multiplication target gates complete
Exact theorem types, standard-axiom censuses and measured proof checks
Source/tool/pin integrity, retained extraction links and generated-file freshness
Successful Kraken model vectors, detected semantic mutants and exact formal-negative rejections
Unchanged source/artifact input seals and original checkout
acceptance_criteria.failure_policy: Missing tools, omitted checks, failed or PARTIAL verification, stale reports, changed inputs or unintended negative failures cannot pass.

github_workflows.scope: Corrected local revision; prior hosted attempts failed the path-alias unit test and are recorded separately.

historical_implementer_run.applies_to: the exact script/source bytes sealed by that run; not a full rerun of the CLI follow-up

current_acceptance_record.proof_boundary: Assembly blocks from their register-entry MachineData states under InputContract; no proof of surrounding Rust wrapper operand loads or result stores.
current_acceptance_record.vectors: Kraken model execution vectors through Lean on the host; no original assembly execution on ARM hardware.
current_acceptance_record.historical_record_policy: Dated reports and logs retain their original results and terminology; current acceptance is based on the automated technical criteria here.
